name: Turtle Beach Vulcan keyboards
description: Per-key lighting of the Turtle Beach branded Roccat Vulcan keyboards (vendor 10F5) in direct mode: Vulcan II, Vulcan II TKL and Vulcan II TKL Pro. Same protocol as huedeck.roccat-vulcan. Adapted from OpenRGB's RoccatVulcanKeyboardController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. OpenRGB's mode report (SendMode, kept by the keyboard) is never sent. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/roccat-vulcan-turtle-beach.md and docs/hardware/roccat-vulcan.md.
